articles.title: Ethiopia, Eritrea amass forces along border, heightening war fears: Sources
articles.description: Border tensions rise as Ethiopia and Eritrea mass troops near their border, fueling fears of renewed war in the region.

articles.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea amass forces along border, heightening war fears, sources say
articles.description: Nov 18 (Reuters) - Ethiopia and Eritrea have amassed forces along their shared border, conflict monitors and people tied tomilitias in northern Ethiopia's Tigray region said,fuelling fears of outright war between the historical rivals.The build-up along the border has brought the two armies within striking distance of each other, according to the conflict monitorsACLED and International Crisis Group, a person close to a pro-Ethiopian government militia in Tigray and another person close toanti-government rebels there.
